description: Defines the User entity class with properties such as Id, Username, Email, PasswordHash, Role, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, and associated Tasks. Also includes the UserRole enumeration to specify user roles.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents an application user with identity and profile information, along with associated tasks.

methods.name: Guid.NewGuid()
methods.description: Generates a new globally unique identifier for the user ID.

methods.name: DateTime.UtcNow
methods.description: Sets the creation and update timestamps to the current UTC time when the user object is instantiated.
